title: Cover test-run cursor validation and missing-timestamp pagination boundaries
outcome: Pin the remaining safe-by-inspection cursor validation and keyset ordering edge cases through bounded route tests.
acceptance: Route tests reject base64-valid cursors with wrong JSON shape, unknown fields or empty runId, and cursors over the 4096-character limit; project-scoped cursors are rejected when reused without their project filter.

Pagination tests cover differing startedAt values across a page boundary and missing/null timestamps sorting last, with exact expected order and no assertion weakening, timing sleeps or timeout increases.
Focused regression and maintained full gate pass on the exact reviewed input before completion.
